notes.title: Hotfix #5 | Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Guardians...[/h2][p]
[b]Hotfix #5[/b] is here! Following this update, as our next announcement, we’ll be unveiling some exciting news we’ve been eager to share - something we think you’ll be just as thrilled about as we are. Although we cannot share what it is just yet, here's all the things that will be rolling out with the hotfix![/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/16f60813eb54ec8a60eeacb149da4d610e946af5.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p][b]By popular request,[/b] Procedurally Clams spawn more frequently. Visit sandy and graveling areas near ocean![/p][/*][*][p]Clam Crystals (Pearls) are worth much [b]less.[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]Small chance to find [b]buried chest[/b] when digging up clams. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Red Fox Classic character skin[/b] can now be discovered in game. After completing small puzzle. [/p][/*][*][p]Misc Landscape sculpting fixes. [/p][/*][*][p]Misc misaligned props and foliage fixes. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Portal Menu UI[/b] hover effect fix. [/p][/*][*][p]By popular request, [b]Map Fog[/b] is now completely removed if player unlocks all obelisks. [/p][/*][*][p][b]White Raven[/b] in player homes optimized. (Anim tick paused when out of range.) [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Accessibility Option.[/b] Camera Shake slider. Allows players to manually adjust Camera Shake intensity in game. Can be set to 0. WIP, does not yet effect all boss attacks. [/p][/*][*][p]Characters that use common turtle class (Light Weaver and Loot Tortoise) optimization fixes. Should now pause anim tick, disable cast shadows, and disable movement when out of range. Logic is now shared between all common turtle sub classes. [/p][/*][*][p]Credits Updated [/p][/*][*][p]Character skin that was unintentionally in game [b]removed.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Trying to Hide Pins on Map [b]no longer crashes game.[/b] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Added collision[/b] to a few props that were missing it. This bug was introduced just before launch, terribly sorry! [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Scroll Category[/b] for scrolls not belonging to any major tribe. For future updates. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Tooltip[/b] widget optimized and various other UI optimizations. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Small cursor change[/b] to prevent it disappearing. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Change to F11[/b] behaviour to prevent it from causing cursor to be offset.[/p][/*][*][p][b]F11[/b] now uses Fullscreen Borderless [/p][/*][*][p][b]Announcement Panel[/b] on main menu can now show multiple images in gallery. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Rollback Save[/b] feature now closes modules when executed. [/p][/*][*][p]Misc [b]Translation fixes.[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]Hlods update [/p][/*][*][p]Nav Mesh updated [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/67a210fa6a12f208f427a12dc73479adc78fd45d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to share your feedback & help us keep improving the game, please join our community [url="https://discord.gg/vYcBWqHyKV"]Discord.[/url]   Many thanks to everyone once again for contributing and being a part of this wonderful community! notes.title: Hotfix #4 | Mikayla Memorial
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Guardians,
[/h2][p]Today, we are introducing [b]Hotfix #4[/b]. which brings with it a number of improvements, patches & bug fixes, details of which you can find below. But above all, this update introduces something far more important and close to our hearts: a permanent in-game memorial to [b]Mikayla Raines[/b].
[/p][previewyoutube="vd15cduYUPY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Mikayla was the founder of [url="https://www.saveafox.org/"]SaveAFox Rescue,[/url] a passionate animal caretaker, and a gentle force for good in the lives of countless foxes, and people. We have had the opportunity to collaborate together on some upcoming news for Spirit Of The North 2, and we are fully committed to continue supporting SaveAFox in the coming months and years. We hope this memorial will be a place where you can peacefully, and respectfully remember Mikayla and her legacy.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][b]
A Place to Remember[/b][/h3][p]Nestled in a quiet corner of [b]Fox Village[/b], you will now find a new area dedicated to Mikayla’s memory. At its centre stands a newly-implemented mural of [b]Namara[/b], a character from the world of [i]Spirit of the North 2[/i] inspired by Mikayla herself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/c7fdb743fe62ca81281be7fc2d0de4154bd47313.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Namara’s name means [i]“No Sorrow”[/i] or [i]“The One Who Dispels Sorrow.”[/i] In the game’s lore, she was a gentle caretaker of animals whose home was a flourishing garden full of life - especially foxes. Her kindness, and deep compassion made her beloved by all creatures.[/p][p]You may also notice [b]Finnegan[/b], a small fox who hangs out near the mural, never straying far from Namara’s side. He is always there, resting by her side.[/p][p]Although we never knew Mikayla personally, this is how we choose to remember her: as someone who left beauty and joy in her wake. This memorial is our small way of honouring her. We hope it brings warmth to those who knew her, followed her, or were touched by her spirit.[/p][p]Thank you for sharing this world with us. And thank you, Mikayla, for helping make it kinder. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/8b53568c12ceeac13cac97e6c33f4ed82ac0fe76.jpg"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]SaveAFox tribute area added to Fox Island. Featuring a memorial to Mikayla Raines. [/p][/*][*][p]SaveAFox logo updated in credits.[/p][/*][*][p]SaveAFox Finnegan NPC added to tribute area.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]QOL UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p][b]Sprint Toggle[/b] can now be enabled in settings. When enabled, player can sprint by toggling sprint on and off rather than by holding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Water Rune Improvements.[/b] We felt the Water Rune was underwhelming and gave it a new fun mechanic.  When rune is equipped the player character can jump while in water. Can be used for jumping across water surface or to more easily exit water. Jumping in water uses 1 spirit energy. Water rune swim speed buff decreased from x2 to x1.6. Water Geysers restore spirit energy(unchanged).[/p][/*][*][p][b]40+ Statues of Eona[/b] added through out world in an effort to reduce time spent walking back to graves. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Vixen Skin[/b] added to game with small platforming challenge.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]GAMEPLAY & UI BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Custom drop down menu added instead of menu anchors so scrolls boxes work properly within settings menu.  In preparation to add more settings over the years.[/p][/*][*][p]Player character can no longer bring lit torch into Stag Guardian Encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]Player character can no longer carry items into final Grimnir Encounter. Will auto drop when cutscene begins.[/p][/*][*][p]Waypoint no longer spawns in ending level.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes for Palace of Peace.[/p][/*][*][p]Player can no longer enter Stag Temple from top to access Spirit Form rune early.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot Tortoise Improvements. Mushroom trails are not so far away, spawn on surfaces that can be reached, and mushrooms are evenly spaced along path to follow.  Loot tortoise should now always spawn in Mushroom ring.[/p][/*][*][p]Base Rejuvination (Regaining spirit energy) is now paused while using Spirit Form Abilities.  This change also prevent buffs to rejuvenation from exceeding Spirit Energy drain from Spirit Form.  No more infinite Spirit Form when comboing Spirit Form with Rune of Suffering.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotation bug after closing pause menu. Fixed![/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to Target Jump. Blocking volumes now more efficiently stop traces and no longer produce invalid targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Character friction settings are properly applied when moving from Ice to Grey Sand(Very specific I know... lets celebrate). Fixes issue where fox would continue to slide after exiting ice slides.[/p][/*][*][p]Spirit Form Bug Fix. When returning from spirit form to a "ragdolled" body (because of death or being struck by something) body will remain in ragdoll until recovery or respawn. Returning to dead body will no longer cause the body to play "wake-up" animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Spirit Form Bug Fix. Controls are no longer locked when body is "ragdolled"  while player is in spirit form.[/p][/*][*][p]Spirit Form Bug Fix. Spirit form no longer experiences strange movement and rotation issues when body is "ragdolled".[/p][/*][*][p]Ram Boss melee attack range and melee trigger range are equal. Ram will no longer get stuck in endless melee attacks if player is nearby but out of damage range.[/p][/*][*][p]Stationary Stone Torches now properly deactivate Moon Runes when lit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed container that was missing loot. New drop location for Water Rune.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]OPTIMIZATIONS[/h3][list][*][p]Continued environment optimization. Removed foliage hidden under static meshes.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt HLODs.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt Nav mesh.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]ENVIRONMENT & LEVEL FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Continued environment polish. Fixed various misalign geometry.[/p][/*][*][p]Collision fixed for particular river.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced problematic cliff mesh throughout world.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot added to a few locations that were missing loot containers.[/p][/*][*][p]More environment clean up. (floating rocks, misaligned cliff mesh edges, etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Jump Targets block around player home mirrors.[/p][/*][*][p]Foxy Home doors now auto open from both sides.[/p][/*][*][p]Free portals (like those in glacier tunnels) now handle more edge cases. Fixed bug that caused player to teleport to wrong location OOB if player target jumped through portal. Also added fade to black for smoother transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Misc Environment meshing fixes. Near Thief's Demise.[/p][/*][*][p]Decorative torches will now ignite flammable items(like held torches) but not player character. These torches are also no longer jump targets.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]VISUAL POLISH[/h3][list][*][p]Waterfalls no longer causes fox to bubble from mouth.[/p][/*][*][p]Crossfox skin color and saturation adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]High Global Illumination now correctly impacts performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Furless Fox Bug. Fixed issues that caused character fur to be hidden but skin visible when returning from Spirit Form while camera is close to character and materials are faded.[/p][/*][*][p]Misc VFX optimization  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]AUDIO POLISH[/h3][list][*][p]Optimization for footstep VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]UI Pause Menu Open SFX now aligns with player input.[/p][/*][*][p]Rune Ability Wisp Form now has SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Rune Ability Wisp Form now allows player to "chirp" like a wisp[/p][/*][*][p]Player Wisp Form chirp SFX updated. Now uses sound from SOTN1.[/p][/*][*][p]Player Wisp Form listener location updated(Can hear things near wisp instead of near fox.)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]MISC CHANGES[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to Announcement Panel in Main Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Framework for accessing announcement data from website (Work in Progress).[/p][/*][*][p]Framework for future DLC implementation completed (All platforms).[/p][/*][*][p]Credits removed from main menu in preparation for addition UI features.[/p][/*][*][p]Translation changes for Sun Wolf name in several languages including English. Was Okama and now is Okamu.  Many languages already used this alternative spelling to avoid association with a Japanese slur.[/p][/*][*][p]Water Rune description updated for all languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Misc typo fixes in various languages like Spanish and Russian.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Translation for recent UI additions such as "Enable Toggle Sprint".[/p][/*][/list][h3] 
CONSOLE UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p]Coming very soon
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you once more. With love,[/p][p][b]Infuse Studio & Silver Lining Interactive[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778840/Spirit_of_the_North_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #3 | Month 1 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Guardians,[/h2][p]Thank you for you patience and ongoing feedback. We’ve been listening closely, reading every report, and working hard behind the scenes to deliver a more stable, immersive, and beautifully optimized experience. Today, we’re rolling out [b]Hotfix #3 the Month 1 Update[/b] - live now![/p][p][b]Here’s what’s included![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][/img][/h3][h3]🔄 SAVE SYSTEM UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p][b]Backup Save System:[/b] The game now automatically creates a backup save every 25 minutes (max 10 backups). You can rollback to these if your main save is corrupted or soft-locked. Access this via Manage Save Data menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Game Naming:[/b] Simplified save file names (no special characters); Names are shorter to fix issues caused by file names becoming to long for some devices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Name Auditing:[/b] Long or invalid save names are now automatically corrected to conform to new system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Copy Fixes:[/b] Copying an original save multiple times during different play sessions no long causes new copies to overwrite existing copies. New save names are now unique.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Offline Achievements:[/b] Now properly tracked.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/09f2fbd6354ca8c9dda54f9492f31ff1ddeeb4a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]💆 QOL UPDATES[/h3][list][*][p][b]Keybinds on PC:[/b] "M" opens map, "Esc" opens Exit Menu. "Tab" still returns to your last visited tab.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Panning Map:[/b] Smoother and no longer clamped.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🕹️ GAMEPLAY & UI BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p][b]D-Pad Input Adjustments:[/b] D-pad up/down are no longer zooms the camera as these inputs are mapped to Fat Travel Home and Photomode. Zooming remains a PC-only feature (mouse wheel).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pressure Plate Fixes:[/b] Now reset properly if associated objects despawn or reset, fixing several soft-lock issues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lava River Platforms:[/b] now spawn properly when you load game already in proximity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Destructible Ram Door:[/b] Now retains its broken state after being destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stormy Home Key Fix:[/b] No longer unlocked by unlocking Stormvale Portal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tomb of Heilda:[/b] Stone elevator fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ashlands Snake Shrine:[/b] puzzles fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Statue of Eona in Fox Island Cave:[/b] No longer overrides Home location when activated if main story is completed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Waypoint Fix:[/b] Waypoints now correctly place on grave icons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scroll Pop-up:[/b] Scroll count display fixed.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 OPTIMIZATIONS[/h3][list][*][p][b]Reflection Quality Fix (Low Settings):[/b] PC visuals now look as intended. notes.title: Hotfix #2 | Week 2 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings Guardians! 🦊 [/h2]

We’re excited to share that Hotfix #1.3, CL 12895, now live on PC, with the console update arriving in just a few days! This patch brings a host of important fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and community-requested changes. Let’s dive in:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]
[h3]🔧List of fixes[/h3]
[*] Collection Removed At End Of Game.  Fixed issue that caused players to lose their collection(Relics and Keys) after finishing game if they died before reaching a Statue of Eona.
[*]Save Game Repair. We implemented a script that audits and repairs your save file that runs automatically when you select a save game to play.  Currently this includes fixes for those who's Relics and Keys were deleted at the end of their game. The game will re-add them when you relaunch your save game. This script also attempts to re-add your Raven companion if you have a Glide Rune but no Raven.
[*]Landscape and Cliff meshing around Misthaven Northern gate.  Waterfall and pond added to prevent players from accessing Highlands with a torch.
[*]Jump Gate in North Misthaven now uses standing stone for activation(requires spirit form). 
[*]Stag Temple now traps player inside to force them to use Spirit Form.  Many players were obtaining Spirit Form and just leaving. 
[*]Progress Lost issue #1.  The Ram Encounter would continue to block autosave if the player abandoned it.  This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.
[*]Progress Lost issues #2.  Some puzzle involving hiding wisps and cutscenes would not stop blocking autosaves. This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.
[*]Removed rogue lever in front of Bear Guardian Temple.
[*]Various fixes to Fox Island behavior and appearance when returning after end of game. ie Killbox under wooden bridge will not be present. Also plugged hole leading to portion of cave that is intended to be inaccessible.
[*]Lighting changes for Lumen on Xbox Series S
[*]Mosswood Foliage Cleanup.
[*]Added ext triggers for some Stormvale structures.
[*]Internet Time Events now uses our own website.  This should fix the issue of events like the Light Weaver not being blocked in countries like Russia. We will continue to test and work on this and thank you for you ongoing patience.
[*]Added Bear Roar SFX to end encounter.
[*]Added missing lava SFX
[*]Misc fixes for environment holes and and misaligned meshes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support for our small team. Your reports and suggestions help make Spirit Of The North 2 the best it can be. As always, we’ll be keeping an eye out for your thoughts and suggestions!


[b]Infuse Studio & The Silver Lining Interactive Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/6107c7f8e20e0d28bb7bbc0ab7e594e5b0095cd0.png[/img]
[img]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings Guardians! [/h2]

Thank you so much for all the support and kindness you've shown our small team in the first week of our game's launch - we're overwhelmed with the amount of support! You've been incredibly helpful by sharing the bugs and issues you've encountered. 

There are still issues to address and it's likely others will pop up, the five of us are quickly looking to address what we can by importance and volume and we've been hard at work implementing a number of fixes to issues you, our community highlighted. These include;

[h3]Gameplay changes & fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've added a Wisp after the glide cavern, to help guide the player towards Mosswood
[*] In the Sunfire passage, the door that requires pressure plates, now requires rope pulls to open it, allowing players to backtrack if they want
[*] The Raven logic has been updated. Now, Thought the Raven will return to you even if you choose not to follow her directions
[*] Murals now ignite regardless of Thought being with you or not. Now murals will always be lit, so you don't miss then on the change Thought has gone on her own little adventure..
[*] Tweaks to the Sunfire passage to make the area more consistent and streamlined
[*] The Guardian Intro Cutscenes now only play once per gameplay session
[*] Added an additional condition for Thought joining you, fixing for players who managed to miss her
[*] Dropped Items now disappear after 3 minutes instead of 2
[*] The Raccoon Cleanup Crew will hold items for a full 10 seconds before taking it (instead of 5), giving the player more time to react

notes.title: Spirit of the North 2 Development Update.
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello folks,[/h1]

Spirit of the North 2 is mere days away and we’re beyond excited for you to immerse yourselves in this atmospheric adventure about Fox and their Raven companion. As we near ever closer to SOTN2’s release we wanted to address the experiences many of you had with the demo that was released last year. 

First off, we want to say a genuine and heartfelt thank you to everyone who shared their feedback and critiques. Not only was the feedback valid and invaluable, the sheer volume of separate Discussion threads and associated comments reiterated to us how much love you all have for our game and your anticipation for the next instalment. 

While we didn’t respond to you all directly, the Infuse team did write about the SOTN 2’s demo, optimization, origins, impacts of using UE5 during its Beta phase while simultaneously developing a new game and the goals for SOTN 2 as a whole. All of which you can read [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1778840/discussions/0/4696783943311038989/]here[/url].

To continue with our goal of transparent communication we want to give you more information and context about what the team at Infuse have been working on since the SOTN 2 demo originally launched and how this work will prevent many of the challenges you experienced in the demo happening in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/e557538e3ca3b72e0465752ae35809e06a91b284.jpg[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
The last months of 2024 were spent [i][u]solely [/u][/i]on optimisation. Everything from weather, the in-game day/night cycle to UI and menu performance, has all been looked at to try and squeeze every last frame out of the game to make it as smooth an experience as possible. 

[h2]Onboarding[/h2]
There have been changes to the opening portions of the game when it comes to player onboarding. As a semi open world game with vast areas to explore, it was important to find the right balance between not showing players a dotted path in front to follow whilst also not making them feel lost with no sense of direction.
 
With the help of things like Red Smoke trails guiding players to all major dungeon locations ([i]a feature call-back to the original Spirit of the North[/i]), you are able to explore the beauty and wonder of the world until your hearts content knowing that all you need to do is look for these Red Smoke Trails to instantly get back on track. This, along with other tweaks in the opening level have been designed specifically to show mini examples of SOTN 2’s gameplay loop players will experience once they are let loose into the world.

[h2]Story and Cutscenes[/h2]
It's important to make players care about the journey they are undertaking and to care about the relationship between the fox and the raven as you help each other navigate a vast world. By far the most important way is to finalise and add in fully rendered in-engine cutscenes as well as beautifully hand drawn ones that appear during each Guardian encounter.

[h2][i]More [/i]Optimisation![/h2]
More recently we have done extensive compatibility testing to try and make sure we can recommend the minimum and also best suited specs for the game. As an Unreal Engine 5 title, it will need a powerful rig to see it in all its beauty but we've tried to make it as accessible as possible to players that don't have super up to date machines. There are extensive settings to tweak to your liking and even on low settings, still is a sight to behold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/bd91cdc97198522f9525b8cc7227dac15c3d79e9.jpg[/img]

We understand that everyone may not have access to the hardware required to run this game. The minimum and recommended specifications are listed on SOTN 2’s store page and we’ve also included them below. We want to ensure as much as possible that everyone can make as much of an informed decision as possible when it comes to purchasing our game.

[h2]Minimum:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
[*] OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
[*] Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
[*] Memory: 16 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 / Radeon RX 6800
[*] DirectX: Version 12
[*] Storage: 25 GB available space
[/list]
[b]Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 30, Graphics Setting Preset: Low[/b]

[h2]Recommended:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
[*] OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
[*] Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X / Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
[*] Memory: 16 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / Radeon RX 7800 XT
[*] DirectX: Version 12
[*] Storage: 25 GB available space
[/list]
[b]Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 60, Graphics Setting Preset: High[/b]

We hope this information and context gives you some assurance to the quality of the game we’re making. Thank you so much to our community, old and new, for the level of support you’ve shown the developers, Infuse Studio and Spirit of the North 1 & 2. We’re humbled by your support. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778840/Spirit_of_the_North_2/

See you in the wilderness!
Silver Lining Int and Infuse Studio
